title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Balance on Which the Guaranty of an Assumed Loan Is Figured
content:
For a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan assumed by a buyer, the guaranty that stays in force is figured on a balance chosen from the loan record (first payment due date, unpaid principal balance and original loan amount) and from the partial claim entries and partial claim repayment entries in the loan's money transactions.

## The balance figured

1. Where the loan's first payment is already due, its unpaid principal balance is below the original loan amount and no partial claim is owed on it, the guaranty is figured on that unpaid principal balance.
2. Where the first payment is already due, the unpaid principal balance is below the original loan amount and a partial claim is owed on it, the guaranty is figured on that unpaid principal balance less the partial claim still owed, the partial claims paid less the repayments received, never less than zero.
3. Otherwise it is figured on the original loan amount.

The first payment is already due when its due date on the loan record is before today.

## Truth table

| First payment already due | Unpaid principal balance below the original loan amount | Partial claim still owed | Balance figured |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | None | Unpaid principal balance |
| Yes | Yes | Some | Unpaid principal balance less the partial claim still owed, never less than zero |
| Yes | No | Any | Original loan amount |
| No | Any | Any | Original loan amount |

## Cases (hypothetical loans, original loan amount 250,000.00)

| First payment due | Unpaid principal balance | Partial claims paid | Repayments received | Balance figured |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Due | 231,400.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 231,400.00 |
| Due | 231,400.00 | 18,000.00 | 3,000.00 | 231,400.00 less 15,000.00, or 216,400.00 |
| Due | 231,400.00 | 18,000.00 | 18,000.00 | 231,400.00 (nothing still owed) |
| Not yet due | 250,000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 250,000.00 |
